name: o-json: read and fold formatted JSON

actions.label: Find the matching bracket
actions.caption: % jumps to the closing brace of the first record. See where this JSON object ends without counting nested braces.

actions.label: Fold one JSON collection
actions.caption: z c folds the first record. Hide its values temporarily while keeping the surrounding JSON readable.

actions.label: Fold every nested collection
actions.caption: z M closes all JSON folds. Start with a compact overview of a deeply nested response.

actions.label: Open a folded collection
actions.caption: z c folds the record first; z o opens it again. Reveal the values when you are ready to read them.

actions.label: Open every JSON fold
actions.caption: z M folds the response first; z R opens every fold. Read the complete formatted JSON without opening each object separately.

actions.label: Toggle a JSON fold
actions.caption: z a toggles the selected fold. Open or close the collection with one chord when you already know its current state.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
